subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw change the canonical Chinese locale IDs from `zh-CN`/`zh-TW` to `zh-Hans`/`zh-Hant` across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs publish metadata, generated i18n artifacts, and saved preferences?
rationale: The request is semantically reasonable but changes public locale values and persisted state across generated and user-facing surfaces, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
options.body: Migrate runtime, wizard, docs publish metadata, generated assets, tests, docs, and saved preference handling together in one reviewed change.

options.title: Keep current region IDs
options.body: Treat `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as OpenClaw's stable user-facing locale contract and keep improving terminology under those IDs.

options.title: Defer to broader i18n planning
options.body: Keep the issue as backlog until maintainers settle the long-term localization contract and docs publish shape.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
recommendation.body: Migrate runtime, wizard, docs publish metadata, generated assets, tests, docs, and saved preference handling together in one reviewed change.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has current-main blame and recent merged history on setup/docs locale surfaces, making him the best available owner for the cross-surface contract decision.
